mentions.name: flowerpil
mentions.description: A platform for creating and sharing cross-platform music playlists. The backend is fully automated for imports and exports from DSPs (streaming services), and playlists can be made with a single account or without one, so music can be shared with friends via a single link.
mentions.problem: Sharing music across streaming platforms is difficult; the author wanted it to be easier to share music with friends with one link, particularly as music listeners start to de-spotify.
mentions.audience: Friends and music listeners, particularly people leaving Spotify
mentions.source_excerpt: a platform for creating and sharing cross-platform playlists
